name: Jászberény (Hungary)
description: A vertical light blue banner charged at the centre with the town arms of Jászberény (a blue shield with a figure, with a helm, a crest and red and blue mantling) above the name JÁSZBERÉNY in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Jászberény arms with helm, crest and mantling
